prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one new square standalone close portrait for human Du Xing (杜兴), nickname 鬼脸儿, for an existing Water Margin RTS encyclopedia/HUD. Not a grid, no sprite sheet.
Input1 is the 3x3 portrait atlas, IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY for the BOTTOM LEFT character in source rectangle x0,y800,width388,height400 of the 1200x1200 image. Ignore the other eight men. Input2 is Du Xing's actual current walking-strip body reference for brown knotted cloth headband/topknot, short dark beard, brown cloth and restrained bronze/olive lamellar armor. Do not copy or approve its long curved blade weapon: this image is a head-and-shoulders portrait WITHOUT weapons.
Canon boundary: Chapter47 explains he is human, from Zhongshan prefecture, called Ghost Face because his facial appearance is rough/coarse; it also identifies him as a trusted steward and shows him donning armor and carrying a spear in one encounter. The nickname is not a demon mask or supernatural identity. Exact facial shape, head cloth and armor detail are game art design, not a claim of literal novel costume instructions.
Primary request: keep recognizable rugged human identity while making a more individually readable face: a broad, weathered face with heavy uneven brows, deep brow/nose folds, sturdy broad nose and square jaw, short coarse dark mustache/beard, alert intelligent eyes, stern but composed expression. Natural warm tan human skin, no supernatural skin color. Brown-olive cloth forehead band tied around a dark topknot, plain coarse brown collar and modest bronze/olive lamellar shoulder edge consistent with the current body reference. He is an experienced human retainer, not a monster, skull, zombie, ghost, sorcerer, caricature or costume-mask wearer. No fangs, horns, face paint, invented scars, glowing eyes or magic effects.
Composition: large CLOSE head-and-shoulders, three-quarter facing toward screen-right. Head and face dominate roughly the central 60 percent of the square; no hand or weapon to crowd the face. All hair/headcloth fully contained with generous 8-percent safe top and side margin, shoulder/collar naturally extends out of lower edge. Distinct strong face readable at 64px and coarser 32px, simple silhouette, avoid tiny armor ornaments.
Style: restrained historical Chinese ink-and-opaque-paint portrait with controlled dark contour, subtle paper/brush texture, warm full-frame parchment backdrop and soft even warm lighting; matching the game's standalone portrait family. No flat gray/white atlas cell background. No text, nameplate, border, symbols, watermarks, turtle/lion animal motifs, weapons, blood, new story event or casualty. Keep him distinct from the neighboring atlas characters.
